challenges: ガンダムサバーニャ: glossary 'Gundam Zanbanya' (official, jigoku_glossary:robot:70, note 'spelling corrected to akurasu' from the akurasu Z3.2 mech list) should be 'Gundam Zabanya': Gundam Wiki page title 'GN-010 Gundam Zabanya' (https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/GN-010_Gundam_Zabanya), the akurasu Gundam 00 movie page ('Gundam Zabanya', https://akurasu.net/wiki/Mobile_Suit_Gundam_00_The_Movie:_A_Wakening_of_The_Trailblazer), the akurasu Z3.2 pilot database (Lockon Stratos default unit 'Gundam Zabanya') and Wikipedia's movie article all spell it Zabanya; only the mech-list table has the extra n. 'Sabernya' (suggested in the brief) is NOT attested in any source I read, so it should not be used. Search the source pages: I found no 'Sabernya'.

宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング: glossary 'Celestial Being (mothership)' has brackets mid-sentence. The bracket is a Gundam Wiki page disambiguation, not part of the ship's name. Suggest 'Celestial Being mothership' (prose: 'aboard the Celestial Being mothership', 'Celestial Being mothership' reads correctly). The ship is also written ソレスタルビーイング号 (pilot 167) = 'Celestial Being'; see names record.

脳量子波: glossary 'Quantum Brainwaves' (Title Case) breaks the sentence-case rule of NAME_RESEARCH.md; Gundam Wiki writes it lower case ('quantum brainwaves', https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Innovators : 'utilize quantum brainwaves', also 'QBWs'). Suggest 'quantum brainwaves' (prose: 'through quantum brainwaves', 'abilities such as quantum brainwaves').

ＵＮ: glossary 'UN' (Universal Network, Original keywords 28/84/136/137) is being used in Gundam 00 prose for 国連 (United Nations); see the new names record 国連 and the retoken list. The English 'UN' itself is fine for both; the fix is a separate token. The Universal Network keyword could also be spelled out 'Universal Network (UN)' in its own entry, orchestrator's call.

ＧＮ－ＸⅢ / ＧＮ－ＸⅣ (glossary 'GN-X III'/'GN-X IV', from the akurasu movie page) versus the akurasu mech list and Gundam Wiki page title 'GNX-803T GN-XIV': not wrong (Gundam Wiki lists both 'GN-XIV' and 'GN-X IV'), but the two akurasu pages disagree; I followed the glossary in ＥＬＳ　ＧＮ－ＸⅣ = 'ELS GN-X IV'.
retoken: 国連 ($$ＵＮ$$ -> $$国連$$, English stays 'UN'): Gundam 00 entries pilot 149, 150, 153, 154, 158, 168, 178, 179 (DSCR and DSC2; each 'the $$ＵＮ$$ forces' translates 国連軍). Also wherever the library Japanese says 国連 in other series: keyword 32, 55, 110, pilot 299, 307, 314, 316, 537, robot 213. Leave $$ＵＮ$$ untouched only where the Japanese says ＵＮ (Universal Network: keywords 84, 136, 137).

地球連邦 ($$地球連邦$$ -> $$地球連邦#00$$, 'Earth Sphere Federation') in Gundam 00 entries pilot 150, 156, 166, 172, 173, 174, 175 (DSCR and DSC2; 173-175 also contain 地球連邦政府). The plain $$地球連邦$$ stays for Original, Char's Counterattack, After War Gundam X and Universal Century prose.

地球連邦軍 ($$地球連邦軍$$ -> $$地球連邦軍#00$$, 'Earth Sphere Federation Forces') in Gundam 00 entries pilot 164, 165, 166, 167, 168, 176, robot 83, 84, 85, 89 (DSCR and DSC2). Plain $$地球連邦軍$$ stays elsewhere (Char's Counterattack and others).
ミーナ: prose already uses $$ミーナ#pt169$$ (pilot 168 DSC2); its record is in names with token ミーナ#pt169 = 'Mehna'. No change needed.
ＥＬＳ: prose already uses $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$; the robot entries (86-92, RBTN/RBN2) use ＥＬＳ#robot. Both records = 'ELS'. No change needed.
uncertain: Earth Sphere Federation split: I gave the Gundam 00 federation its own tokens (#00). If the orchestrator prefers one 'Earth Federation' everywhere, drop the two #00 records and the retoken lines; nothing else depends on them.
Sol Braves (ソルブレイヴス): Gundam Wiki writes both 'Solbraves' and 'Sol Brave Squadron'; no Bandai English text found. Kept 'Sol Braves' (Jigoku), status proposed.
ライセンサー: rendered 'license holder' from Gundam Wiki wording; the film's official English term is unverified (proposed).
太陽光発電紛争 'Solar Power Wars' and 来たるべき対話 'dialogues to come' are franchise-wiki wording, not confirmed official titles (proposed). The film may use 'the Coming Dialogue'; I could not verify.
オーライザー: '0 Raiser' (digit) chosen to match '00 Raiser' and '0 Gundam'; Jigoku shipped used a letter O. Pronounced 'O Raiser'; the digit form is Gundam Wiki's page title.
ミスター・ブシドー: 'Mister Bushido' (Gundam Wiki, Jigoku) versus 'Mr. Bushido' (Wikipedia); either is acceptable, kept the spelled-out form.
アリー・アル・サーシェス: 'Al-Saachez' (Wikipedia) versus 'al-Saachez' (Gundam Wiki); kept Wikipedia.
ソレスタルビーイング号 = 'Celestial Being' assumes the film's deep-space mothership; it is the same ship as 宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング.

Gender: unknown for the President (pilot 175); the Japanese for Shirin, Klaus, Descartes, Setsuna and others has no pronoun, so gender rests on Gundam Wiki and the voice actors. Tieria is treated as male (Japanese 彼なりに; Gundam Wiki lists Innovade as male).

レイフ・エイフマン: official spelling is 'Ralph Eifman' (Wikipedia), not the romanization 'Reif' that Jigoku shipped; sourced from Wikipedia only (Gundam Wiki page for him could not be fetched), status official with medium confidence.

Pilot 165 CHNN コーラサワー / CHFN パトリック・マネキン (glossary, official) and パトリック・コーラサワー in prose (pilot 167) are the same person: English 'Patrick Colasour' for the latter, 'Patrick Mannequin' for the legal post-marriage name. A reader could think they are two people; prose in pilot 165 explains it.
Gundam Wiki page for 'Patrick Mannequin' is a different character (a Build Fighters character), so it must not be cited for the Gundam 00 Colasour.
